lens: Every printed number re-derived from the artifact that produces it, not from another sentence.

p1s.summary: 'but six gene loci against five' carries the sentence's whole point — that predicted transcriptome load separates the two reagents ONLY before the hits are counted by gene — and no instrument read it. Inverting it reverses the finding.
p1s.fix: test_the_locus_recount_that_reverses_the_load_comparison_is_the_tables_own binds both counts to aso-per-junction-table.json AND asserts the reversal, so a rewrite keeping both numerals but dropping the relation fails. Ablation-verified.

p1s.summary: 'reported doubling times of five to six days' had a committed source (emc-test-article-routes.json's verbatim quotation of PMC9813045) but no binding; a previous round measured the same sentence surviving a mutation to 'one to two days'.
p1s.fix: test_the_models_doubling_times_bracket_what_the_paper_rounds_them_to parses 5.09 and 6.05 out of the committed quotation and asserts each rounds to the endpoint printed for it. Ablation-verified.

p2s.summary: 'that parent is wild-type NR4A3' reads as membership over an argmax value; 62 designs have NR4A3 pairing >=10 bp, and four of the 87 have two qualifying parents, so 'that parent' has no unique antecedent for them.
p2s.fix: All three sites now name the predicate — 'the longest such duplex is against wild-type NR4A3' — with the pins and both guards updated to require it and to refuse the two earlier phrasings.

p2s.summary: 'covers every position of GRCh38' / 'It counts every position of GRCh38' overstates by 4.88%: 151,138,112 of 3,099,747,808 windows carry an N and were skipped.
p2s.fix: Reworded to 'covers GRCh38 end to end ... skipping only windows that carry an ambiguous base' and 'It scans the whole assembly rather than the transcriptome'. ⚠ The artifact's own method.completeness still reads 'definitional: every position is tested'; correcting it needs a re-run of the genome screen, which is CI, so it is recorded and not hand-edited.

p2s.summary: 'those partial duplexes are not counted here and have not been measured' is true of the work but cheap to close; the seat measured 9 bp (EWSR1) and 10 bp (TAF15) at the exon-2/exon-3 seam, both with the gap incompletely paired.
p2s.why: True as written and it confirms 'neither in full'. Printing the two figures would need a committed artifact home and the abstract is at its 200-word cap. Recorded so a later round does not re-file it as new.

p2s.summary: fusion-junction-aso-reagent-coverage.json, inside the 515-file deposit, gave a reason for not naming the third design that the paper's own test-articles section now contradicts.
p2s.fix: The field now states the paper's reason; the retired sentence is retained verbatim under a withdrawal key (rule 1.2) with why it is wrong.

p2s.summary: aso-per-junction-table.json covers 187 of the panel's 190; three designs returned screen_failed in the DEEP pass and dropped out with no trace, while n_designs_screened was written from the truncated list.
p2s.fix: aso_per_junction_table._deep_screens now returns the absent designs beside the graded pairs and junction_rows records them per junction; 187 rows + 3 absent = 190, and a junction with only absent designs no longer disappears.

repository_findings.summary: test_journal_article_numbers.py forbids the membership phrasing in the journal article while test_aso_parent_gap_pairing.py requires it of the extended report.
repository_findings.why: Deliberate and not a contradiction: the extended report is a frozen deposited checkpoint whose text cannot be edited, only superseded, so a guard over it must describe what it SAYS. Recorded in the extended-report guard so the next session does not 'harmonise' them.

repository_findings.summary: The 3-of-190 join gap lives in aso_per_junction_table.py.
No committed artifact carried the evidence for 'FUS ... in two of five variant cases in a recent series' (PMID 41755350) — the one number the seat could not re-derive.
repository_findings.fix: The abstract was retrieved from PubMed and its NGS sentence committed to lit-targets-aso-breakpoint-census.json under its own truthful provenance block; test_the_fus_partner_count_is_the_retrieved_abstracts_own reads the two and the five back out of the quotation and asserts 'variant' survives, because the series selected for variants and the figure is not a prevalence. Ablation-verified.
